name: Afastor Corporation
summary: Afastor Corporation, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as an agent specializing in the distribution of information technology products across the country. The company's extensive catalog includes a diverse range of items such as mobile computing devices, data storage solutions, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), various computer peripherals, digital multimedia systems, household appliances, electronic signboards, and factory automation control equipment, among other product lines.
